heatmap.title: Relative similarity
heatmap.single: One similarity level. Colors are relative to this query, not confidence.

ingest.title: Input Frames
ingest.purpose: Select usable Frames from the capture.

recon.title: Reconstruction
recon.purpose: Estimate geometry and camera poses from the Keyframes.
recon.outputs: Depth, camera poses and reconstructed geometry

align.title: Metric alignment
align.purpose: Align the room with a level floor and a vertical Z axis.
align.outputs: Metric aligned geometry, floor and ceiling heights

mesh.title: Geometry
mesh.purpose: Build the colored point cloud and room surface.

segment.title: Segmentation
segment.purpose: Distinguish candidate things in each view using the Vocabulary.

lift.title: 3D Instances
lift.purpose: Associate masks across views to identify distinct 3D Instances.

embed.title: Object embeddings
embed.purpose: Represent each Instance for open-vocabulary search.

objects.title: Objects
objects.purpose: Publish Objects with their boxes and Object Membership.
objects.outputs: Objects with boxes, and Object Membership
